stem: Meera reads about neutralisation in her Science class. Which statement about using neutralisation in daily life is not correct?

options.text: Rubbing a mild base such as baking soda on an ant bite can reduce the effect of the acid injected by the ant.
A farmer can add slaked lime to acidic soil to reduce its acidity before sowing crops.
Adding more acid to basic soil will make the soil even more basic.
A factory should treat its acidic waste water with a base before releasing it into a river.

teacher.key_rationale: A base opposes an acid: baking soda neutralises the ant-bite acid (A correct), slaked lime neutralises acidic soil (B correct), and basic treatment neutralises acidic factory waste (D correct). C is incorrect because adding acid to basic soil neutralises the base, making the soil less basic, not more basic.
